item.name: Get the active tariff plan for the given organization

request.name: Get the active tariff plan for the given organization

description.content:
Retrieve detailed information about the currently assigned `tariff_plan` of the given organisation.
It can either be accessed for the own organisation or a direct child organisation.
The `applied_price` field is calculated using the currently active SIM cards for the month.

response.name: Success

description.content: Added as a part of security scheme: bearer

header.description:
(Required) An `auth_token` should be provided to authenticate a session.

To obtain an `auth_token`, see the [`/api/v1/authenticate` **POST** request](/developers/api/authentication/authenticate).

response.name: Organisation not found or no active tariff plan

description.content: Added as a part of security scheme: bearer

header.description:

To obtain an `auth_token`, see the [`/api/v1/authenticate` **POST** request](/developers/api/authentication/authenticate).

description.content:
Retrieve a list of all Tariff Plans that are available for the given organisation.
The available tariff plans for one's own organisation can also be retrieved with a call to
`/api/v1/organisation/my/tariff_plan`

response.name: Success

To obtain an `auth_token`, see the [`/api/v1/authenticate` **POST** request](/developers/api/authentication/authenticate).

item.name: Retrieve your organization's active tariff plan

request.name: Retrieve your organization's active tariff plan

description.content:
Retrieve detailed information about your organization's assigned `tariff_plan`.

<Info>
  The `applied_price` field is calculated based on the active SIM cards for the current month.
</Info>

description.content:
The emnify REST API gives programmatic access to the emnify IoT SuperNetwork — global cellular connectivity for IoT devices. Manage SIMs, endpoints (devices), service and tariff profiles, events, SMS, eSIM (SGP.32) profiles, organizations, users, API callbacks, and the Data Streamer. Authenticate with application tokens or user credentials; tokens are short-lived JWTs.
